name: Act break through black

source.description: 2 inspected reference films (batch-2, batch-3, 2026-11-26): a wordless story short separates its acts with a fade through black and cuts plainly inside each act.

technique: In a wordless story, acts are separated by a fade to black, a short black hold and a fade up on the next location; the black reads as time passing. Location changes inside an act are plain cuts.
purpose: Signal time passing between acts of a story; keep the plain cut for location changes inside an act.
visual_behaviour: The act ends in a 0.8 s fade to black, black holds 0.8 s, and the next location fades up in 0.6 s; the film opens and closes with 0.5 s fades.
mechanics: Fade out 0.8 s (ref-1e22836116 23.6-24.4 s), black hold 0.8 s (24.4-25.2 s), fade up 0.6 s (25.3-25.9 s); opening fade in 0.5 s (3.4-3.9 s); closing fade 0.5 s (43.2-43.7 s); cuts inside acts at 9.90 and 34.60 s.
failure_modes: On a light-canvas film fade to the film's own background (see empty-stage-dip)
With narration running, a 0.8 s black hold breaks the no-static-frame rule unless it sits in a narration pause

implementation.approach: Studio.transition crossfade through a black layer: outgoing opacity to 0 over 0.8 s, hold 0.8 s, incoming from 0 over 0.6 s. In a light-canvas film fade to the film's own background instead (empty-stage-dip).

provenance.observed: Fade to black 0.8 s, hold 0.8 s, fade up 0.6 s between the stair and the lantern room; the film opens and closes with 0.5 s fades.
Fade to black 0.5 s, black 0.7-0.9 s, fade up 0.7 s between acts (22.0-26.9 s and 37.7-39.2 s); inside each act the stage never cuts.
